review.notes: Full review. One P2 finding: the last sentence of the route of 2.2 states a false exponent identity (one-symbol repair); no stated result is affected. Sample: all nine targets 1.0-2.4 checked against Gardner's notes and slides (11 locators, all agree); Kelly 1957 not readable (text requested), Bondy-Murty read only as reproduced in the notes, Lovasz 1972 and Muller 1977 uncertified. Adversarial pass by hand and by an independent script (decks of all graphs on at most 6 vertices, Nash-Williams' lemma, criteria counts 159 and 76, 196 regular graphs, 72 triples): all README values reproduced. Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry the only warning; one-tactic probe closes none of the 7 theorems. Dependency check: 0 problems. Automatic checks all passed, none set aside. The sources service recorded four entries in the package's sources.toml during this review (two certified author-page texts, two uncertified journal articles with Crossref-resolved DOIs) and one request for Kelly 1957.
